items.title: Artists boycotted this portrait prize over AI entries. Now they’re back to take them on
items.original_title: Artists boycotted this portrait prize over AI entries. Now they’re back to take them on
items.summary: After two years shunning the Brisbane portrait prize, several artists are entering again, with some First Nations painters counting on another AI – ‘ancestral integrity’ – to help them win Poised above the lady in the red dress is a claw. Its metallic fingers grasp to pluck its prize from a jumble of other women while she looks dreamily upward, as if to say “Who, me?” The woman in the red dress is Australian comedian Alice Fraser, as photographed on stage. The other women – generic superheroes and 1950s housewives – were created using the generative AI software Krea. Continue reading...

items.original_title: Cosmo Whyte Returns to the University of Michigan With a Powerful New Exhibition at Stamps Gallery
items.summary: Stamps School of Art & Design alumnus explores memory, migration, and who shapes history in an exhibition spanning drawing, sculpture, and installation. On view through December 12, 2026.
